name: 書式付きメッセージの転送編集
prompt:
Recreate the full Japanese message-transfer editor shown in the component preview on an exact 390×880 px white canvas. The native preview is authoritative for wording, hierarchy, typography, geometry, spacing, card boundaries, and toolbar. Use the original screenshot crop only to understand the forwarded post and identify its hyperlink; follow the preview for all Japanese localization and content.

Make one deliberate color correction: inside the forwarded post, render only the actual hyperlink 動画の資料 in clear blue #1976D2 with no underline. The source English text is Youtube and is visibly a hyperlink. The native text layer is green, but the source shows that it is a link. Do not recolor the Cancel or Send actions, the toolbar button labeled リンク, the channel chip, member names, code heading, or any other text. Preserve their current colors.

Reproduce all details from the preview: top actions キャンセル / メッセージを転送 / 送信; channel chip 交流のアイデア; composer line みなさんに共有します。; forwarded post and its author, body, nested list, quote, code heading and literal code, member names and attribution; and the complete bottom formatting toolbar with its labels and icons. Preserve the green initials avatar, mint channel chip, thin card outline, quiet quote divider, pale mint code block, green member/code accents, gray attribution, and exact Japanese spacing. Keep every label legible at native size without enlarging it; do not add the English source text, keyboard, status bar, extra controls, @ symbols, or new decoration. Do not invent a link destination URL. The color change to 動画の資料 is the only intended visual difference from the native preview.
reviewNotes: v001 compared with the 390x880 native preview. Only the semantic forwarded-post link 動画の資料 is blue #1976D2; Cancel, Send and toolbar リンク remain controls. Main copy, quote, code, footer and toolbar are present. The card begins lower and occupies more height; type and vertical gaps are noticeably larger. Raw ImageGen path and SHA-256 are in review-w02-a001.json; full frame used without cropping.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
